title: Advanced SELECT [JOIN (RIGHT)]
description:
## RIGHT JOIN
RIGHT JOIN is the mirror of LEFT JOIN. It keeps ALL rows from the RIGHT table, even if there's no match in the left table.
```sql
SELECT users.name, deployments.app
FROM deployments
RIGHT JOIN users
    ON deployments.user_id = users.id;
```

In practice, you can always rewrite a RIGHT JOIN as a LEFT JOIN by swapping the table order. Most developers just use LEFT JOIN.


---
## Assignment:
Using a RIGHT JOIN, show all usernames and their invoices amounts. Users with no invoices should still appear.
